definitions.explanation: A decorative band or ring worn around the wrist or arm as jewelry or an accessory.

examples.english: She is wearing a silver bracelet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}{先|さき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕輪|うでわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a handmade bracelet at my travel destination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕輪|うでわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出土|しゅつど}→出土：11760_shutsudo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A gold bracelet was unearthed from ancient ruins.

notes:
USAGE:
{腕輪|うでわ} is the native Japanese word for bracelet. In modern everyday speech, ⟦ブレスレット→ブレスレット：04892_buresuretto⟧ (from English "bracelet") is more commonly used for fashion accessories, while {腕輪|うでわ} is preferred in historical, traditional, or formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腕輪|うでわ} (gold bracelet)
- {腕輪|うでわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はめる (to put on a bracelet)
- {腕輪|うでわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ (to take off a bracelet)

FORMS:
⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧ (arm) + ⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧ (ring, circle). The ⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧ component appears in ⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧ (ring [for fingers]).
